actions.title: First prompt
actions.description: Run prompt with the description AND evaluate the model AND get score

actions.title: Run classes prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect classes: There are some problems with the classes in the model.
prompts2: - The following classes are missing: <List of classes separated by comma>
- The following classes should not be part of the model: <List of classes separated by comma>
- <Class 1> should [not] be abstract.
actions.fewShot: An example of a class is....

actions.title: Run data types prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect data types: There are some problems with the data types in the model.

missing.template: - The following data types are missing: {0}

actions.fewShot: An example of a class is....

actions.title: Run inheritance prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect inheritance: There are some problems related to inheritance.
prompts2: - <class 1> should inherit from <class 2>.
- There should not be an inheritance relationship between classes <class 1> and <class 2>.
actions.fewShot: An example of a class is....

actions.title: Run attributes prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect attributes: There are some problems with the attributes in the model:
prompts2: - Class <class name> is missing attribute/s: <list of attribute names>
- Class <class name> has the following extra attribute/s: <list of attribute names>

actions.title: Run associations prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect associations: There are some problems with the associations in the model:

missing.template: - The association between classes {0} (with role {3}) and {2} (with role {1}) is missing.

prompts2: - The association between classes <class 1, class 2> is missing.
- The association between classes <class 1, class 2> is missing. (<description>)
- There is an association between classes <class 1, class 2> that should not exist.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a composition association.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a aggregation association.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a standard association.

actions.title: Run association ends prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect association ends: There are some problems with the association ends in the model:

missing.template: - The association end from class {0} with name {1} is missing.

prompts2: - The association between classes <class 1, class 2> is missing.
- The association between classes <class 1, class 2> is missing. (<description>)
- There is an association between classes <class 1, class 2> that should not exist.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a composition association.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a aggregation association.
- The association type between classes <class 1> and <class 2> is wrong. It should be a standard association.

actions.title: Run assoc mult prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect associations multiplicities: There are some problems with the associations multiplicities in the model:
prompts2: - The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) should expect <cardinality_class 1> <class 1> to be related with <cardinality_class2> <class 2>.
- The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) have the multiplicities of each entity in the reverse side.

actions.title: Run assoc role prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect associations identifiers and roles names: There are some problems with the associations and roles names in the model:
prompts2: - The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) have either no relationship identifier or roles names.
- The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) have either a generic association identifier or generic roles names.
- The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) have the roles names of each entity in the reverse side.

actions.title: Run assoc classes prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect association classes: There are some problems with the association classes in the model:
prompts2: - The association between classes <class 1, class 2> (with the name of <associationName>) and the class <class 3> itself should be part of an association class represented by <class 3>.

actions.title: Run operations prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect operations: There are some problems with the operations in the model:
prompts2: - The class <class 1> is missing the next operations: <List of operations separated by comma>.
- The class <class 1> should not have the next operations: <List of operations separated by comma>.
- The operation <operation> from class <class 1>, does not have the correct parameters: <List of parameters separated by comma>.
- The operation <operation> from class <class 1>, should return <operation type>.

actions.title: Run enums prompt
actions.prePrompt: Incorrect enums: There are some problems with the enums in the model:

missing.template: - The enum {0} is missing the next values: {1:*}

prompts2: - The constant values <values…> (, as the values that can be found in the attributes <attr1… from class 1;attr2… from class 2>,) should be part of an enum.
- The enum <enum 1> should not have the next values: <List of values separated by comma>.
- The enum <enum 1> is missing the next values: <List of values separated by comma>.
